bundle.shortDescription: Desktop IPTV player with EPG and watch history
bundle.longDescription: Lumen is a fast, lightweight desktop IPTV player supporting M3U, Xtream Codes and XMLTV EPG, with a virtualized channel list, interactive guide, search, per-title resume, and watch history.
